entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

O na God, na i pilere, kanire te beten di iterama di erienga. Na malia wen di iteiwa. Na niminin ta milekiwa, i niminin go milinwa. Na kalkan ta paina tekimua, i kal muru wen paitomua.
God ta ta milekimua, i teran wen milinwa. Talame Ugain ateral de erune i kenin erinwa. I ibal ta ta erionga milekinwa, i inin kaia mile paingal painwa.
